fieldNotes.location: Confirmed at 2132 Downyflake Lane, Allentown, PA 18103. Roster geocode moved 88m and resolved correctly onto the large industrial building. Verified via web search (D&B - cereal breakfast foods manufacturing).
fieldNotes.ownership: Roster source (Hyster GM plant list) is stale. The building now carries 'AAi' signage - American Atelier Inc., a hospitality/institutional furniture manufacturer - and web directories list American Atelier at 2132 Downyflake Ln alongside the historical General Mills cereal listing. The physical building audited is the correct site for the roster entry.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The building's parking lot and truck yard connect directly to the public road via open driveways - no barrier arm, sliding gate, fence line, or checkpoint pinch-point visible in satellite or Street View imagery. Open site. truckGate=false; flagged uncertain.
